recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-17391 unless OO reopens the later Observation.note wording policy.
issue_request: FHIR-17391 was a Published OO change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking to add laboratory test-level comments to Observation because STU3 Observation.comment was described as comments about the result; the accepted modification was to clarify the comment definition as comments about the test result value rather than add a new element.
initial_application: Historical commit 99532b4c0a applied GF#17391 by changing the Observation.comment spreadsheet source to 'Comments about the test result value' and adding explanatory text about significant, unexpected, or unreliable result values and source information relevant to interpretation.
additional_context: FHIR-17576 later changed the same element from Observation.comment 0..1 string to Observation.note 0..* Annotation and broadened the current wording to comments about the observation or results. FHIR-18157 corrected a typo in that explanatory text. FHIR-17522 expanded Annotation.author[x] to include Organization, PractitionerRole, and Device, addressing the seed-comment concern that lab or instrument comments need not be tied to a person. Observation is active in the current build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Observation.note already covers comments about the observation/test and results, and Annotation supports organization/device authorship, so reverting to the narrower STU3 wording would conflict with later decisions.

related_jiras.note: Changed the same element to Observation.note 0..* Annotation and established the current broader wording; already represented on the combined branch.
Corrected a typo in the post-FHIR-17391 comment/note explanatory text; already represented on the combined branch.
Expanded Annotation authors to Organization, PractitionerRole, and Device, supporting lab- or instrument-generated notes; already represented on the combined branch.
